check1_zeroBuffDigestIdentity.method: A/B in ONE process: base blob 033877ad extracted via `git show` into /tmp/dbimpl-base, vs the post-change worktree module. Divergence is then classified by replaying the same run and counting DROP_SPAWNED + DROP_DENIED.
check1_zeroBuffDigestIdentity.verdict: PASS — divergence occurs if and only if the buff system engaged. The gate condition is `divergedWithZeroDropRolls === 0`.
check1_zeroBuffDigestIdentity.divergenceCause: Uniform +2 actor-id renumber (enemy-100 -> enemy-102, pickup-113 -> pickup-115, projectile-131 -> projectile-133): the shared `nextId` counter is consumed once for `drop-<n>` and once for `buff-<n>`. This is spec Open risk 7, documented as intended and unavoidable. `waveSchedule` and `waveVariant` are byte-IDENTICAL in those same diverged runs, which is the direct proof `run.rng` was never consumed.

deliberateDeviations.reason: It reds `an item pickup applies both gate maximum and current integrity` (tests/defense-run-simulation.test.mjs:978 asserts itemsCollected === 1; measured 7) — one of the nine tests §6.2 requires to pass UNCHANGED. That counter means PERMANENT stage items: app.js renders it as '아이템 N' beside the kill count and it moves in lockstep with `run.itemIds`, which a buff drop never joins. Counting buff drops in it makes the HUD claim 7 items while the player holds 1, contradicting the spec's own §2 premise that BUFF_ITEMS and ITEMS are disjoint catalogs.
deliberateDeviations.replacementRationale: A new `progress` key changes the serialized shape for every run and breaks the byte-identical-digest proof. The value is derivable from `buffs` and the BUFF_APPLIED/BUFF_REFRESHED event stream.
deliberateDeviations.preserved: The ITEM_COLLECTED emit is retained exactly as specified, so audio/VFX/HUD consumers are unaffected.

deliberateDeviations.action: ADDED `reconcileGateCap(run)` = Math.min(gate.integrity, effectiveGateMax(run)), called at the end of expireBuffs, clearBuffs, AND evictOldestBuff
deliberateDeviations.reason: Check 11 requires `gate.integrity <= gate.maxIntegrity` on the expiry tick, which a pure filter cannot deliver. Of the 8 gateMaxIntegrity read sites the 3 damage clamps are provably inert (clamp(integrity - damage, 0, cap) with damage >= 0 never reaches the upper bound), but the 5 that RAISE integrity — recovery headroom, recovery amount, retry floor, terrain-recovery budget and clamp — let bulwark-echo x2 fill cinder-span's gate to 1920 against a base 1600, so on expiry the HUD would read 1920/1600.
deliberateDeviations.safety: Never writes gate.maxIntegrity, so R14 holds. Math.min can only cap, never grant. Identity in every unbuffed run, so check 1 is unaffected. Phase A precedes every gate write in the tick.
deliberateDeviations.authority: Confirmed by DropBuffSystem (spec author, who called check 11 unsatisfiable as written and identified evictOldestBuff as a third removal path) and ratified by the director as R39.
